title.zh: 修订第 296 号共和国法（即 1948 年《司法法》）第 90 条与《菲律宾法院规则》第 93 条第 1 条的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Ninety of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred and Ninety-six, Otherwise Known as the Judiciary Act of Nineteen Hundred and Forty-eight, and Section One of Rule Ninety-three of the Rules of Court in the Philippines
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Ninety of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred and Ninety-six, Otherwise Known as the Judiciary Act of Nineteen Hundred and Forty-eight, and Section One of Rule Ninety-three of the Rules of Court in the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1951/ra_643_1951.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section ninety of Republic Act Numbered Two hundred and ninety-six is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 90. Concurrent jurisdiction to appoint guardians. - Justices of the peace and judges of municipal courts of chartered cities shall have concurrent jurisdiction with the courts of first instance to appoint guardians or guardians ad litem for persons who are incapacitated by being of minor age or mentally incapable in matters within their respective jurisdiction."

Section one, Rule ninety-three of the Rules of Court in the Philippines is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

Where to institute proceedings. -Guardianship of the person or estate of a minor or incompetent shall be originally cognizable by the Court of First Instance of the province where the minor or incompetent resides, and if he resides in a foreign country, by the Court of First Instance of the province wherein his property or part thereof is situated: Provided, however, That the justice of the peace courts or municipal courts of chartered cities shall have concurrent jurisdiction with the court of first instance in cases where the value of the property of such minor or incompetent falls within the jurisdiction of the latter courts."

The rules of procedure provided for in the Rules of Court in the Philippines shall be followed so far as their application shall be practicable in the justice of the peace courts and municipal-courts of chartered cities.
The provisions of laws and rules of court inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 12, 1951.
